scenarios.name: crisis
scenarios.description: PHQ-9 Item 9 > 0 only on night 6. Override must fire that night and never before.

scenarios.name: single_night_spike
scenarios.description: One elevated night inside a stable week. Must not reach Alert on its own.

scenarios.name: slow_drift
scenarios.description: About three weeks of gradual respiratory-rate drift. Must reach Watch before Alert.

scenarios.name: stable_week
scenarios.description: Seven steady nights around the personal baseline. Must never reach Alert.
